title: Design System: Marcus Portfolio — Screening Room

display.purpose: Owner identity and large project headings.

label.purpose: Short navigation, kind, and status labels.

motion.name: selection-feedback
motion.purpose: Color and border response on filmstrip and action links; transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reading-scroll
motion.purpose: Anchor navigation only; switches do not animate or delay content.

components.name: Filmstrip project selector
components.description: Chooses a catalog project while keeping its name and state readable independently of color.
components.css: .ds-filmstrip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; width: 100%; min-height: 3.55rem; padding: .52rem .3rem; border: 0; background: var(--night-panel); color: var(--paper); font: 600 .9rem/1.15 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-filmstrip:hover { color: var(--sunflower); } .ds-film-number { display: grid; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; } .ds-filmstrip[aria-pressed=true] .ds-film-number { border-color: var(--sunflower); background: var(--sunflower); color: var(--ink); } .ds-filmstrip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Artifact disclosure
components.description: High-contrast publication boundary immediately adjacent to the selected artifact.
components.html: About this artifact Fictional prototype data; not a live connection.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin: 0; padding: .66rem 1rem; background: var(--sunflower); color: var(--ink); font: 400 .83rem/1.4 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure strong { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Artifact action link
components.description: Named full-size or public-site action with a clear focus and hover state.
components.css: .ds-artifact-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--paper); font: 600 .76rem/1.25 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-artifact-link:hover { border-color: var(--sunflower); background: var(--sunflower); color: var(--ink); } .ds-artifact-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Screen metadata rail
components.description: Names the currently selected projection and announces project changes.
components.html: On screenPeople, compiled · local interactive prototype.
components.css: .ds-screen-meta { min-height: 2.25rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(1rem, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr); align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .4rem .85rem; background: var(--night-deep); color: var(--mist); font: 600 .72rem/1.4 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-screen-signal { width: .48rem; height: .48rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); } .ds-screen-rule { height: 1px; background: var(--rule); }

components.name: World navigation
components.description: Six real destinations with a distinct active-route rule and a horizontally scrollable compact state.
components.html: Field AtlasScreening RoomArcade MarqueeDada Contact SheetVU Meter BridgeClassic Index
components.css: .ds-world-nav { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; font: 600 .72rem/1.4 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-world-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; flex: none; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; padding: .35rem 0; color: var(--mist); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-world-nav a:hover, .ds-world-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--sunflower); } .ds-world-nav a[aria-current=page]::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: .12rem; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--coral); content: ''; } .ds-world-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This route is an interface critique room: the authentic project artifact is the feature, while the portfolio shell names what is on screen and how it can be inspected. It opens on the actual, sandboxed People, compiled dashboard rather than a device mockup, fabricated case-study image, or promotional hero. The shared archive supplies every title, description, disclosure, image, local demo, and verified public link.

Electric midnight is cut by a precise off-white projection field and small coral, mint, and sunflower registration signals. The signals identify focus, selection, and publication status; they never imply data or performance. Each displayed project keeps its own visual identity inside the screening frame.
keyCharacteristics: A narrow identity-and-filmstrip rail gives the live artifact most of the desktop width.
The current project's name, type, publication boundary, and real action stay adjacent to its artifact.
The filmstrip is text-led; it does not invent thumbnails for records without reviewed media.
The same named archive links work without JavaScript; enhanced buttons add project switching.

rules.name: The Evidence-Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent colors mark navigation and disclosure only; they never encode a measurement, outcome, or live connection.

dos: Do let the shared public project catalog supply every title, kind, description, disclosure, asset, demo, and live link.
Do keep the real interactive People screen visible first and clearly label its fictional data.
Do show link-only projects as useful external-site states without inventing a preview.
Do preserve the project's own identity inside the frame and reflow the archive at narrow widths.
donts: Don't copy pixels, text, or metrics from a generated development comp into published content.
Don't embed the Gaia sites or publish the excluded Gaia Research hero artwork.
Don't turn synthetic data into a real client or outcome claim.
Don't add fake browser chrome, device mockups, gradients, glass, or an equal-card gallery in place of the working screen.
